description:
**About GlobalFoundries**
GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com.
  
  
MIPS by GlobalFoundries company is a microprocessor pioneer with deep roots in RISC-based computing. Today, MIPS is building RISC-V processor solutions for high-performance and embedded applications, combining CPU architecture expertise with platform software, tools, and ecosystem enablement.
  
  
**Join the RISC-V Revolution at MIPS!**
**Introduction**
We are looking for hands-on embedded software engineers to develop AUTOSAR-compliant MCAL components for next-generation MIPS RISC-V automotive real-time MCUs. You will work across driver development, hardware bring-up, safety-compliant engineering, integration, and validation for applications including ADAS, powertrain, body electronics, and domain controllers.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Develop and maintain AUTOSAR MCAL drivers for peripherals such as ADC, PWM, GPT, ICU, DIO, PORT, CAN, LIN, SPI, UART, WDG, MCU, FLS, and Ethernet.
* Own assigned MCAL modules across requirements analysis, design, coding, configuration, unit testing, integration, and validation.
* Implement software in compliance with MISRA C and AUTOSAR coding guidelines, and resolve findings from static-analysis tools.
* Create software design descriptions, configuration guidance, test specifications, traceability, and other required engineering work products.
* Bring up and debug MCAL drivers on FPGA and silicon using Lauterbach, iSystem, or similar embedded debug tools.
* Collaborate with SoC architecture, hardware, platform software, functional safety, validation, and tools teams on clocks, resets, interrupts, DMA, memory maps, and peripheral integration.
* Integrate MCAL components with AUTOSAR BSW stacks and configuration environments, and support system-level issue resolution.
* Develop automated unit, integration, and regression tests and contribute to CI-based quality checks.
* Participate in code reviews, design reviews, defect analysis, and continuous improvement of reusable MCAL components.

**What You Should Have**

* 4-6 years of embedded software development experience, including meaningful hands-on AUTOSAR MCAL or low-level driver development.
* Strong embedded C programming skills and practical knowledge of pointers, memory-mapped I/O, interrupts, concurrency, and linker or startup concepts.
* Experience developing or integrating MCAL modules and working with AUTOSAR specifications and configuration workflows.
* Good understanding of MCU subsystems including clocks, resets, interrupt controllers, DMA, timers, watchdogs, communication peripherals, and memory interfaces.
* Experience with MISRA C, static analysis, code reviews, unit testing, and requirements-to-test traceability.
* Working knowledge of ISO 26262 software development practices and safety-oriented engineering deliverables.
* Experience with hardware bring-up and debugging using Lauterbach, iSystem, J-Link, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or similar equipment.
* Experience with Git and scripting in Python or shell for build and test automation.
* Ability to read hardware specifications and translate register-level behavior into reliable production-quality drivers.

**Good to Have**

* Hands-on use of EB tresos Studio, Vector DaVinci Configurator, or equivalent AUTOSAR configuration tools.
* Experience with Vector, Elektrobit, ETAS, or another third-party AUTOSAR BSW stack.
* Exposure to tools such as Polyspace, QAC, Tessy, Cantata, or equivalent static-analysis and unit-test solutions.
* Knowledge of RISC-V architecture or experience moving MCAL software across MCU architectures.
* Exposure to ASPICE, safety audits, tool qualification, customer delivery, or OEM/Tier-1 integration.
* Experience with automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, Ethernet, and SPI.

**What You'll Get**

* Opportunity to build MCAL software for a new RISC-V automotive MCU platform.
* Direct collaboration with CPU, SoC, functional safety, validation, and platform software teams.
* End-to-end ownership from specification and driver implementation through hardware validation and customer enablement.
* A flexible growth path toward MCAL architecture, functional safety, platform leadership, or deep technical specialization.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Stay current on Oracle HCM Cloud reporting functionality, OTBI enhancements, and industry best practices.

**Qualifications**

* Attention to Detail

* The Credit Risk Data Unit delivers quality-assured, timely and transparent finance-relevant risk data and analysis to key stakeholders. The team manages end-to-end processes for critical risk metrics, maintaining strong controls, regulatory compliance and operational efficiency while using data, automation and AI-enabled capabilities to improve accuracy, insight and decision-making.
* This role sits within the Global Risk Data Control and Validation Group Function team, which aggregates, validates and submits credit exposure data to FDW in line with BCBS standards. The data supports the Bank’s downstream regulatory and regional reporting, including Credit Risk RWA, Leverage Exposure and Regulatory Capital. RDV-GF is part of the Credit Risk Data Unit within Group Finance and works closely with CRDU, Business Finance, Accounting Close, Book Runners, source-system teams and FDW IT support. The process is centrally managed from Pune and combines strong control execution with continuous improvement, intelligent automation and responsible use of AI.

**What We’ll Offer You**
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
  
  

* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your Key Responsibilities**
The Risk Data Control group are responsible for :
  
  

* Process relevant feeds and adjustments in strategic systems to ensure high-quality data flows into regulatory reporting platforms.
* Manage transaction, collateral and facility data from strategic source systems and approved manual feeds across all in-scope asset classes and businesses.
* Process risk feeds, branch ledger and sub-ledger data required for monthly reconciliations.
* Produce reconciliations against control checks and the posted balance sheet, investigate exceptions and maintain breaks within agreed thresholds.
* Distribute break details, obtain clear commentary, identify root causes and coordinate timely resolution with product control and other stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to simplify controls and use workflow automation, analytics and AI-assisted tools to improve data quality, reduce manual effort and strengthen operational resilience.

Responsibilities/Tasks:
  
  

* Act as the subject matter expert for assigned risk data control processes and provide clear guidance on controls, data lineage and issue resolution.
* Ensure data submitted to Group regulatory reporting systems is complete, accurate, validated and correctly mapped to key reference data.
* Deliver reconciliations and control checks against the posted balance sheet, investigate exceptions and keep breaks within approved analytical thresholds.
* Perform supervisory quality assurance reviews within agreed service levels and maintain complete, audit-ready evidence.
* Provide production support during unplanned absences, platform stabilization and business continuity scenarios.
* Serve as the first point of escalation for operational, control and data-quality issues.
* Coordinate issue resolution with the Team Lead, Operations Manager, technology teams and other stakeholders; track actions through to sustainable closure.
* Support post-process reviews of performance, incidents and control outcomes; identify root causes and drive corrective and preventive actions.
* Monitor workload, capability and overtime; escalate capacity or delivery risks and support effective allocation of work.
* Maintain current process, control and data-lineage documentation and support regular control reviews.
* Build team resilience through cross-training, knowledge sharing and effective backup coverage.
* Review management information, trends and key indicators covering monthly submissions, control performance and data quality; translate findings into concise stakeholder insights.
* Use approved automation, analytics and AI-enabled tools to detect anomalies, priorities exceptions, accelerate root-cause analysis and improve reporting, with appropriate human oversight and adherence to data-security, model-risk and governance requirements.
* Identify, assess and document automation opportunities; define requirements, support testing and measure benefits such as reduced manual effort, improved accuracy and faster turnaround.
* Support the Team Lead in setting clear objectives and providing fair, evidence-based performance feedback aligned with organizational standards.
* Support change-the-bank projects and strategic improvement initiatives, including data, automation and AI use cases.
* Partner with Change teams to maintain and deliver a prioritized remediation book of work based on data-quality and process diagnostics.
* Coordinate with project teams to deliver improvements to processes, controls and outputs, including requirements definition, user acceptance testing and implementation readiness.
* Ensure effective audit engagement, evidence coordination and timely closure of findings.
* Support the Team Lead with resource planning, succession planning, training, development and adoption of new digital capabilities.

**Your Skills And Experience**
Experience/Exposure:
  
  

* 6–7 years of relevant experience in credit risk controls, banking operations, finance, audit, change delivery or business process improvement.
* Good understanding of banking products, including debt, securities financing transactions and derivatives, with working knowledge of Global Markets products.
* Working knowledge of credit risk management, Basel requirements and regulatory guidance relating to risk-weighted assets, leverage exposure and IFRS 9 credit loss measures.
* Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint; practical experience with SQL, workflow automation tools is desirable.
* Hands-on experience identifying and implementing process automation, such as low-code workflows, robotic process automation, scripting or automated controls.
* Practical understanding of AI and machine-learning applications in data quality, anomaly detection, document analysis, root-cause investigation or management reporting.
* Experience using generative AI or AI assistants responsibly to improve productivity and insight, including prompt design, output validation, human oversight and protection of confidential data.
* Strong reconciliation and quantitative analysis skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and communicate clear conclusions.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across teams, functions and regions.

title: Senior SAP Consultant (Transport Management)
description:
**About TechOrbit:**

Tech Orbit Solutions is a fast-growing IT consulting organization delivering SAP-led digital transformation programs across multiple industries. The company focuses on high-quality consulting, strong delivery governance, and long-term client partnerships. We are building deep SAP capabilities across GROW with SAP, RISE with SAP, and AMS models, with a strong emphasis on ownership, rigor, and solution excellence.

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking an experienced SAP Transportation Management (TM) Functional Senior Consultant to lead end-to-end transportation process design and implementation across SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and Private Cloud environments. The consultant will own fit-to-standard workshops, solution configuration, integration, testing, cutover, go-live, and hypercare. The ideal candidate must have completed at least 2–3 full-cycle SAP TM implementations and be available to join immediately or at very short notice.

**Key Responsibilities – SAP TM Functional Consulting**

* Lead end-to-end SAP TM implementation activities, from discovery and fit-to-standard workshops through design, configuration, testing, deployment, and hypercare.
* Design and configure transportation processes including transportation demand, freight unit building, planning and optimization, tendering, execution, tracking, settlement, and charge calculation.
* Translate business requirements into scalable functional designs aligned with SAP Best Practices and a clean-core approach.
* Configure transportation master data, organizational structures, transportation lanes, calendars, resources, equipment, conditions, profiles, and planning settings.
* Lead functional specifications for interfaces, forms, reports, enhancements, APIs, workflows, and migration objects.
* Plan and execute unit testing, string testing, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, regression testing, and defect resolution.
* Lead data migration, cutover planning, business readiness, go-live support, and transition to AMS.
* Communicate risks, dependencies, assumptions, and design decisions clearly to client stakeholders and project leadership.

**Public Cloud & Private Cloud Responsibilities**

* Deliver SAP TM scope in S/4HANA Public Cloud using fit-to-standard principles, SAP Best Practices, standard configuration, in-app extensibility, and released APIs.
* Design SAP TM solutions for S/4HANA Private Cloud, including embedded TM and side-by-side integration scenarios where applicable.
* Understand Public Cloud scope boundaries and identify requirements that require process redesign, approved extensibility, or integration with complementary solutions.
* Maintain clean-core discipline by challenging unnecessary customization and documenting justified extensions.
* Support SAP Central Business Configuration activities for Public Cloud and configuration governance for Private Cloud.
* Work in line with SAP Activate methodology, including Explore, Realize, Deploy, and Run deliverables.

**Core SAP TM Functional Scope**

* Transportation demand and freight unit management, order-based and delivery-based transportation processes.
* Freight order and freight booking management for road, ocean, air, rail, and multimodal scenarios.
* Manual and optimizer-based planning, load consolidation, scheduling, routing, and resource utilization.
* Carrier selection, tendering, subcontracting, execution monitoring, event management, and proof of delivery.
* Freight agreement, charge management, calculation sheets, rate tables, freight settlement, and cost distribution.
* Integration with SAP SD, MM, LE, EWM, FI/CO, Business Network for Logistics, and external logistics platforms.

**Integration & Delivery Leadership**

* Own integration design across Order-to-Cash and Procure-to-Pay transportation processes, including sales orders, purchase orders, stock transfers, deliveries, freight documents, and settlement documents.
* Collaborate with SAP SD, MM, EWM, FI/CO, ABAP, BTP, integration, data, and security teams.
* Guide interface design using APIs, IDocs, web services, middleware, and event-based integration as relevant to the target landscape.
* Mentor junior consultants, review functional deliverables, and ensure consistent quality across the TM workstream.
* Contribute reusable assets, process flows, configuration workbooks, test packs, cutover checklists, and knowledge-transfer material.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 7+ years of relevant SAP functional consulting experience, with strong hands-on expertise in SAP Transportation Management.
* Minimum 2–3 successful end-to-end SAP TM implementations, including at least one S/4HANA implementation.
* Hands-on experience with both SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and Private Cloud transportation solutions.
* Strong understanding of transportation planning, execution, carrier collaboration, freight charging, and settlement.
* Practical experience leading workshops, configuration, functional specifications, testing, cutover, go-live, and hypercare.
* Good understanding of SAP Activate, fit-to-standard delivery, clean-core principles, and cloud extensibility boundaries.
* Excellent analytical, stakeholder-management, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, own the TM workstream, and coordinate effectively across global teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in manufacturing, automotive, FMCG, retail, chemicals, logistics, or distribution-intensive industries.
* Exposure to SAP EWM, SAP Business Network for Logistics, Global Track and Trace, or carrier integrations.
* Experience with international and domestic transportation, multimodal planning, and complex freight costing.
* Experience supporting pre-sales, solution estimation, proposal inputs, client demonstrations, or solution walkthroughs.

**Education & Certifications**

* BE / BTech / MCA / MBA or equivalent qualification.
* SAP S/4HANA Transportation Management certification preferred.
* SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition implementation certification or SAP Activate certification is an advantage.

title: Sr. Full Stack Developer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Tech Lead to spearhead the modernisation of a large-scale enterprise application from legacy ASP.NET to a modern .NET 10 Web API and React stack. You will own the technical direction of a cross-functional delivery pod, mentor a team of developers, and drive hands-on engineering across both frontend and backend.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role — you will write production code, lead architecture decisions, and be accountable for the technical quality of everything your pod delivers. You will work in a structured Agile environment, collaborating closely with the Solution Architect, QA leads, and client stakeholders across a multi-year, multi-phase modernisation programme.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Technical Leadership**

* Own end-to-end technical delivery of your pod — architecture, design, coding, code review, and quality gates
* Lead the migration from legacy ASP.NET (MVC / Web API / Web Forms) to .NET 10 REST APIs and React 18 frontend
* Define and enforce coding standards, branching strategy, and PR review process across the pod
* Produce Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for all significant technical choices
* Conduct structured code reviews covering architecture, security, performance, and maintainability — not just syntax
* Identify and resolve technical debt proactively; maintain a tech debt register visible to stakeholders
* Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps) with quality gates: SonarQube, unit coverage, OWASP dependency scan
* Collaborate with Solution Architect on cross-pod API contracts, shared services, and infrastructure decisions

**Hands-On Engineering**

* Design and build .NET 10 Web API microservices using Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design patterns
* Build React 18 SPAs: component architecture, Redux Toolkit / Zustand state management, routing, and performance optimisation
* Implement OAuth2 / OIDC / JWT authentication and role-based access control
* Design and optimise relational database schemas (SQL Server / PostgreSQL); write complex LINQ and EF Core queries
* Build and consume RESTful APIs with versioning, error handling, and OpenAPI documentation
* Write unit, integration, and contract tests as a core part of the Definition of Done

**Migration & Modernisation**

* Lead the technical approach for migrating legacy ASP.NET code to .NET 10 — analysis, characterisation testing, phased migration, parity validation
* Use GitHub Copilot and AI-assisted tooling to accelerate migration while maintaining review discipline
* Identify breaking changes, deprecated dependencies, and third-party package migration paths
* Establish repeatable migration patterns that the whole pod can follow consistently across modules
* Ensure all migrated code has adequate unit test coverage before merge — parity tests are non-negotiable

**Team Leadership & Mentoring**

* Lead a pod of 4–6 engineers (mix of senior, mid, and junior developers)
* Run daily technical standups, remove technical blockers, and escalate risks to the Architect early
* Mentor mid and junior developers through pair programming, code reviews, and 1:1 technical guidance
* Create a learning environment — internal tech talks, documentation, actionable review feedback
* Make resourcing recommendations and flag capacity risks to the Delivery Manager

**Agile Delivery (Added Advantage)**

* Participate in Scrum ceremonies — Sprint Planning, Daily Standup, Sprint Review, Retrospective, Backlog Grooming
* Collaborate with the Product Owner / BA to refine user stories, provide technical input on acceptance criteria, and raise technical stories
* Provide accurate SP estimates; track sprint progress and flag scope risk early
* Support the Scrum Master in removing impediments with a technical root cause
* Champion the Definition of Done — ensure every story that ships meets quality, test, and documentation standards
